sum: First Northwest Bancorp operates as a bank holding company for First Fed Bank that provides commercial and consumer banking services to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations in the United States. The company accepts various deposit instruments, such as checking, money market deposit, savings, and transaction accounts, as well as certificates of deposits. It also offers one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, commercial and multi-family real estate loans, construction and land loans, loan origination and underwriting, and commercial business loans, as well as consumer loans primarily comprising automobile and home-equity loans, and lines of credit. It operates branch offices in Clallam, Jefferson, King, Kitsap, Snohomish, and Whatcom Counties, Washington. First Northwest Bancorp was founded in 1923 and is based in Port Angeles, Washington.
ceo: Mr. Curt T. Queyrouze (President, CEO & Director)
